title: Evidence type fabric.exec.observation/v1 (spec 053 §3.2, §5.1; spec 056 §4.3)
description: The one item of an exec.subprocess (or, later, exec.audit) record: which subprocess API the hook observed, how the arguments were given, the stdio dispositions the caller chose, the form of the output it received, and whether a pid is known. Metadata only: argv, cwd, environment names and output travel as terminal.* content bodies, never here. Closed: no other property, no free text. audit_event is set only with api audit (spec 053 WP4-02; not registered for a capture point in spec 056 M1).

api.description: META: the observed call. popen is Popen construction; run and check_output share its observer (duplicates suppressed); communicate, wait and poll report an outcome; the asyncio_* values are the qualified asyncio subprocess equivalents; audit is the exec-audit channel.

audit_event.description: META: the PEP 578 audit event name; only with api audit.

argv_form.description: META (N32): argv is a sequence (argv), one shell command string (shell_string), or not exposed to the hook.

stdio.description: META (N33, N34): the disposition the caller chose for each stream; Fabric never changes it.

output_form.description: META (N34): the output the caller received was bytes, text (a str the caller's encoding decoded), or none.

text_encoding.description: LABEL: the caller's encoding name when output_form is text.

observation_index.description: META: the index of this output observation of the attempt (repeated communicate after a timeout).

cumulative.description: META: this observation repeats earlier output (a later communicate after a timeout); its bytes are not new.

timeout_partial.description: META: the output is the partial output an exposed TimeoutExpired carried.

pid_known.description: META: the child's pid is known (Popen returned). A spawn failure is false; no pid is invented.

duplicate_suppressed.description: META: an audit record suppressed because an exec.subprocess wrapper owns the operation.

error_class.description: LABEL: the raised exception class's __qualname__, never its message.
